# QueryDock

> QueryDock is a free in-browser SQL playground for PostgreSQL (via PGlite), SQLite and DuckDB, in English and Russian, and part of the DataTug family.

QueryDock — бесплатная SQL-песочница в браузере для PostgreSQL (PGlite), SQLite и DuckDB, часть семейства DataTug.

No sign-up is required to run queries. Schema, seed data and drafts stay in this browser. Sign in to save a workspace online. Examples and embeds are available. QueryDock does not execute TugQL or GraphQL queries.

## Engines

- PostgreSQL, via PGlite, in the browser: https://querydock.run/en/sql/postgres/ and https://querydock.run/ru/sql/postgres/
- SQLite in the browser: https://querydock.run/en/sql/sqlite/ and https://querydock.run/ru/sql/sqlite/
- DuckDB in the browser: https://querydock.run/en/sql/duckdb/ and https://querydock.run/ru/sql/duckdb/

## Features

- Run SQL with no sign-up. The playground needs JavaScript. Queries do not run until you execute them.
- Build tables and seed data in the browser. Local drafts stay on the device. Download JSON to keep a separate copy.
- Sign in to save online. Saving asks for an explicit confirmation and uploads the complete workspace. Saved revisions are unlisted: anyone with the link can read or run them without signing in.
- Examples, with fictional data, can be run and cloned with no sign-up: https://querydock.run/en/examples/ and https://querydock.run/ru/examples/
- Embeds: an account-free embed at https://querydock.run/sql/embed (the example is carried only in the URL fragment) and a public embed of a saved revision at https://querydock.run/sql/{id}/{revision}/embed
- Open a saved or local workspace in DataTug, a separate product: https://datatug.app/
- English home and playground: https://querydock.run/
- Russian home and playground: https://querydock.run/ru/
- Playgrounds by engine, English: https://querydock.run/en/sql/postgres/run/ , https://querydock.run/en/sql/sqlite/run/ , https://querydock.run/en/sql/duckdb/run/
- Playgrounds by engine, Russian: https://querydock.run/ru/sql/postgres/run/ , https://querydock.run/ru/sql/sqlite/run/ , https://querydock.run/ru/sql/duckdb/run/
